name: Chris Ozols
description: Personal GitHub site of Chris Ozols, with solves of unsolved problems, refutations of accepted claims, standing records broken, improvements to existing solutions, and formulations of new generalizations.

proofs.heading: Solves of unsolved problems
proofs.title: Solves of unsolved problems — Chris Ozols
proofs.description: Proofs of published mathematical conjectures with reproducible Lean verification, exact statements, trust models, and prior-art notes. No novelty or priority is claimed.
proofs.introHtml: Mathematical proofs with reproducible verification in Lean 4. For each one, I couldn't find a previously existing solution on the internet.

refutations.heading: Refutations of accepted claims
refutations.title: Refutations of accepted claims — Chris Ozols
refutations.description: Counterexamples to published mathematical claims, with exact witnesses, Lean verification, and prior-art notes, including disclosure of earlier refutations.
refutations.introHtml: Counterexamples and refutations with reproducible verification in Lean 4. For each one, I couldn't find a previously existing solution on the internet.
refutations.empty: No entries are published yet. Entries are added once the counterexample can be checked independently and its prior-art notes, including any earlier refutations, are complete.

improvements.heading: Standing records broken
improvements.title: Standing records broken — Chris Ozols
improvements.description: Improvements to published best-known records with reproducible Lean 4 verification and prior-art notes.
improvements.introHtml: Improvements on existing records with reproducible verification in Lean 4. For each one, I couldn't find a previously existing solution on the internet.

optimizations.heading: Improvements to existing solutions
optimizations.title: Improvements to existing solutions — Chris Ozols
optimizations.description: Measured improvements to existing software implementations with links to the source commits.

generalizations.heading: Formulations of new generalizations
generalizations.title: Formulations of new generalizations — Chris Ozols
